name: Hinged arch dialogue
idea: A quiet pair-building habitat that faces two makers across a shared threshold, derived from an asymmetrical vaulted arch and counterweighted hinge rather than a capsule or vehicle.
shape_ancestry: one inflated asymmetrical horseshoe grows from a postwar exhibition arch, with a low counterweight lobe and a suspended oval room nested inside the span
silhouette: a wide uneven arch leans over one open threshold, with one short rounded foot and one long lifted shoulder creating a clear sideways balance at thumbnail size
exaggeration: make the lifted shoulder unusually long and thin while keeping the inhabited oval chamber unusually deep and low
aperture_rule: the broad inner horseshoe opening is the entry and conversation threshold; add one small convex observation window inside the chamber, never a flat screen slab
construction_cues: one warm-metal hinge collar marks the shoulder's pivot
one upholstered shared bench bridges the low inner chamber
one rounded docking foot anchors the arch to the ground plane
material_direction: apricot lacquered fiberglass arch, pale lavender resin chamber, smoke-tinted convex glass, warm brass hinge collar, cream upholstery, and soft editorial daylight
